name: Pad kee mao with shrimp
notes: RecipeTin Eats (200 g dried wide noodles, 200 g chicken thigh, 2 tbsp oil, 3 tbsp oyster sauce, 1.5 tbsp each of light and dark soy, 2 tsp sugar, 1 cup basil for 2 to 3 plates), The Woks of Life (8 oz noodles, 12 oz chicken, 3 tbsp oil for 4) and Rachel Cooks Thai (2 tbsp oil, 8 oz noodles for 2). Per plate 200 g of cooked noodles and 20 g of oil; protein is the cooked weight, 60 g.
